head: bny 1 (< MEA bny cf. SL 161-162: to build;)

examples.turoyo: ḥəḷḷi, ḥzeli b-fəlge du=šalwo kal kalá šeno ʕelayto (…) w-b-riše d-i=šeno ko-bnalle quṣro
examples.translation: I looked and I saw: there is a tall cliff in the middle of the valley (…), and on the top of that cliff they have built a stronghold
examples.raw: ḥəḷḷi, ḥzeli b-fəlge du=šalwo kal kalá šeno ʕelayto (…) w-b-riše d-i=šeno ko-bnalle quṣro ‘I looked and I saw: there is a tall cliff in the middle of the valley (…), and on the top of that cliff they have built a stronghold’ RT 3-4;

examples.turoyo: Kfayšo hawxa, kxayfo, kḥawro, gmaydo qalite, d huyo čimənto, zubṭo ak kefe. I naqqa ḥa d maʕmər, d zubṭo ak kefe. I naqqa ḥa d bone, lo, d bone ak kefe šuro flan. (Isaq houses: 14)

examples.translation: die Michaeliskirche ist im Jahre 85 christlicher Zeitrechnung erbaut worden
